latestMarketLearning.thesisResearch: Fresh 2026 search results show strong, current demand for thesis/research planning: Notion's thesis-planning template has 200+ ratings and recent 2026 reviews, Asana actively markets a research-plan template to thesis/dissertation students, and current paid trackers on Gumroad/Etsy emphasize timeline, literature, supervisor feedback and progress tracking. This supports a two-step acquisition funnel: deadline reverse-planning for high-intent scheduling searches plus a progress diagnostic for users who know they are stuck. Differentiation should be research workflow control rather than generic thesis formatting.
latestMarketLearning.thesisFunnelBuild: Created thesis-deadline-planner and thesis-progress-check as separate search-intent tools. The first captures deadline/schedule intent; the second captures stuck/progress-diagnosis intent. Both are standalone, local-only tools and can later route to the queued thesis note or planned thesis OS only after public URLs are verified.
latestMarketLearning.sponsorCrmResearch: Current BOOTH search showed generic Excel CRM/sales-management products around 1480-1980 JPY and higher-priced business systems, while direct sponsor-acquisition workflow products were sparse. The 1680 JPY hypothesis positions the product above generic trackers by covering sponsor-package design, weighted pipeline, payment tracking and benefit fulfillment in one workbook.

optimizationRules: Do not infer a public URL until independently verified.
Do not reduce price merely to increase item count; account for fixed per-order fees.
Prefer complementary bundles when they increase expected average order value and solve a coherent buyer problem.
Use actual sales and message data when available; otherwise state that evidence is still sparse.
Use sales thresholds as signals, not hard gates; strong external demand evidence can justify earlier bundle, license, localization, or funnel work.
Do not reactivate KDP or LINE without explicit user instruction.
Do not impose arbitrary weekly, daily, or per-run production caps. Increase output when quality, demand, originality, and policy compliance are maintained.
If a new-product idea is weak, switch to a stronger idea or materially improve an existing funnel rather than ending the run without a concrete deliverable.
